name: librebooking
description: LibreBooking is an open-source resource scheduling solution. It provides a flexible, mobile-friendly, and extensible interface for organizations to manage resource reservations. The "develop" branch contains the latest code of the project.

paragraphs: Security: upgrade to LibreBooking 7.1.0 or later immediately. All versions before 7.1.0 contain a critical vulnerability that lets an unauthenticated attacker sign in as another user, including an administrator, by forging the "Remember Me" login cookie. Security fixes are not backported, so no fix will be released for 7.0.x or earlier. LibreBooking 7.1.0 removes the "Remember Me" option. Users sign in again once their session ends. If you cannot upgrade right away, configure your web server or reverse proxy to remove the persistlogin cookie from incoming requests. See the security advisory…

Security: upgrade to LibreBooking 7.0.0 or later immediately. All versions before 7.0.0 contain a critical vulnerability that lets an unauthenticated attacker take over an administrator account. Security fixes are not backported, so no fix will be released for 6.x or earlier. If you cannot upgrade right away, delete Web/install/migrate.php or block access to it in your web server. See the security advisory for details and for how to check whether an installation was compromised, and get the latest release.
